register.labelZh: COTTON 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 當某人並非立即明白,而是在稍後才察覺意思、規則或答案時,cotton on 十分實用。；cotton on 可以表示某人看到標誌、表情、例子或其他線索後,逐漸明白發生了甚麼事。；cotton to 可以描述人或動物逐漸喜歡或接受新的對象、地方、習慣或想法。；cotton on 與「明白」有關,而 cotton to 則與「喜歡或接受」有關。掌握兩者有助你更準確地理解口語對話。
register.summaryEn: Cotton on is useful when a person does not understand immediately but later notices the meaning, rule or answer. Cotton on can show that a person works something out after seeing a sign, expression, example or other clue. Cotton to can describe a person or animal slowly becoming comfortable with a new person, place, routine or idea. Cotton on concerns understanding, while cotton to concerns liking or accepting. Knowing both helps you understand informal conversations more accurately.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Use cotton on when someone begins to understand. Use cotton on to something when the sentence names the fact, idea, joke, rule or situation that the person understands. Use cotton to somebody/something when someone begins to like a person or thing, or begins to accept an idea. It often appears in sentences about not liking something immediately.
